title: Kenworth T659, high tensile fully polished custom built Aluminium FUPS Bullbar #67
description: Kenworth T659 high tensile fully polished aluminium FUPS Bullbar custom channel with Hi-Tensile 88mm diameter pipe but optional100mm pipe can be ordered. 100mm box reinforced uprights shown. Cow catcher and four small uprights. Road train signs with covers. Optional Dangerous Goods sign on aluminium backing plate. Aluminium tow plate, option panted steel or chromed plate. Provision for front mudflaps. Driving light mounts to customer requirements Bull bar can be custom built to your requirements.
